scope: Short-clip application inference, not a full benchmark or exact authors frontend reproduction.

text-octopus.actual_prompt: An octopus playing maracas. A single full-body cartoon octopus rhythmically shakes two maracas with its tentacles. Static camera, centered subject, plain white background, consistent shape, all limbs visible.
text-octopus.manual_visual_review: 视频中章鱼抬起和放下触手，但沙锤形状不准确；实际GLB有局部断连和漂浮，不能当作高质量成品资产。

image-mushroom.actual_prompt: An anthropomorphic mushroom character singing opera. Its mouth opens and closes expressively and its arms gesture while singing. Full body remains centered. Static camera, plain light background, consistent shape.
image-mushroom.manual_visual_review: 实际GLB保留蘑菇轮廓，有肢体和嘴部形变；无纹理、没有音频，不能证明准确表达了唱歌剧。

mesh-panda.actual_prompt: A panda casually walking, taking gentle steps in place with natural arm swings. Full body remains visible and centered. Static camera, plain light background, consistent shape.
mesh-panda.manual_visual_review: 实际GLB保留可见纹理，有抬脚和手臂动作；前置视频及网格存在形状与大小变化，走路自然度有限。

sampled_peak_scope: Video generation and ActionMesh stages. Static image anchor has PyTorch allocation/reservation statistics only; see its report.
